CASP+

CompTIA Advanced Security Practitioner

certificationsmedium

CompTIA's advanced-level security certification for hands-on senior practitioners, sitting above Security+ in the CompTIA pathway. In 2024 CompTIA rebranded the certification as SecurityX under its new Xpert series, though the CASP+ name remains widely recognized. It covers enterprise security architecture, operations, and engineering for technical leads who stay hands-on rather than moving into pure management.
